checks.exactSourceGates: Qualification requires HEAD and clean tracked extensions/packages. Stage requires canonical 40-character hexadecimal SHA, matching successful four-step progress, exact ordered gates, unique matching receipts, source hashes verified before/after, 40/40 full-show entries, zero OOM counters and immutable proxy/privacy proof. Candidate scripts are compared to git show of that same source SHA.

checks.backupAndQualification: Deployer retains nonblocking private deployment lock, baseline/config/room rechecks before stop, stopped-application archive with exact tree/hash checks and disk reserve, offline byte/mode/SQLite restore verification, isolated candidate clone with no network or ports, pinned successful receipt bound to source/image/container/config and age <= 24 hours.
checks.rollback: SIGTERM/SIGINT raise guarded failure. Container rollback retains the current customer config volume, verifies the original image/identity, resumes the original container and rechecks public health. No production data restore is introduced. Old container and private backup remain retained.
checks.comparisons: Candidate image/revision, complete stage artifact hashes, environment, mounts, launch contract, other-container identity/image/start time and gateway remain checked. HostConfig comparison remains exact apart from the approved present-null/false OomKillDisable normalization.
checks.observer: Existing stable candidate-image/container/gateway/runtime comparisons, three restart-free samples, retained old container and stopped cache checks remain. Themes/contact/billing probes add only bounded public GETs; HTML vs JSON-object/status checks and hashes are retained.

timeoutSemantics: No timeout is interpreted as success. Deployment deadline first sends SIGTERM for rollback, waits 300 seconds, then reports inspection required without hard killing a still-running guarded deployer.

gitDeployer.normalization: Only explicitly present null maps to false in a deep-copy comparison. True changes, missing/present changes, invalid types and every other host field remain rejected. Replacement payload itself is not normalized.

limitations: Static source/diff review only; no release gates, helper commands, SSH, Docker, backup, rollback or deployment were executed for this review.
The canonical current-release-source record and new source-specific qualification receipts remain required at execution. This receipt does not substitute for them.
The existing zero-room check remains based on retained container log events and explicitly reports checkStopRaceEliminated:false.
Public GET probes establish response availability/shape/hash, not visual host parity, inbox delivery or LIVE payment activation.
